captions.gbp:
Have an ultrasound coming up? How you prepare depends on the type. For an abdominal ultrasound, don't eat for 8 to 12 hours before (water is OK). For a pelvic ultrasound, drink 32 oz of water 1 hour before and don't empty your bladder, because a full bladder gives clearer pictures. Thyroid, breast and vascular ultrasounds need no special prep. Wear loose, comfortable clothes and leave jewelry at home. If you're using insurance, bring your card and your doctor's order, and plan to arrive 15 minutes early. Ultrasound is painless and uses no radiation: warm gel and a smooth probe glide over your skin, and most exams take 20 to 45 minutes. Afterward you can get right back to your day, and results go to your doctor in 48 to 72 hours. Self-pay ultrasound at our Seminole office is $195, with no referral needed and same-day appointments often available. Always follow the instructions from your doctor or our team.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.

RadiologyInfo.org Pelvic Ultrasound: may be asked to drink water to fill the bladder (transabdominal), usually done within 30 minutes, no radiation. NIH MedlinePlus Abdominal ultrasound: likely asked not to eat or drink for several hours; little discomfort, gel may feel cold, probe pressed against abdomen.
